name: Urban Homeless Shelter
tag: City Mission Management Unit, Govt. of Assam
text: Running since 2024, the 15-bed shelter gives homeless and vulnerable people a safe place to stay, with meals, clean water, sanitation, basic healthcare and counselling.

name: HIV Targeted Intervention
text: The drop-in centre at Jorabat reaches female sex workers and people who inject drugs from Byrnihat to Bumphor with HIV prevention, counselling, testing, STI and ART linkage, and community health camps.

name: Land restoration, Kokrajhar
tag: TERI · GEF Small Grants Programme OP-7 · Completed
text: Degraded land restored through agroforestry and herbal plantation, with farmers trained in seed treatment, bio-decomposers, vermicompost and yellow sticky traps for pest control. OP-7 is complete and the next phase under OP-8 will begin shortly.

name: Fish farmer livelihoods
text: BPL fish-farming households received training in scientific fish farming, fish health and feed management, along with fish seed and feed, and met monthly to review progress.

name: Mobile health camp
text: General check-ups, consultations, free medicines and health awareness for communities with little access to medical care.

name: International Yoga Day 2025
text: Students and community members joined a yoga session on International Day of Yoga, 21 June 2025.

name: Women's rights awareness
text: Sessions on gender equality, legal and constitutional rights, protection from domestic violence, workplace rights and government schemes for women.

name: Women domestic workers' meeting
text: Women domestic workers discussed low wages, job insecurity and lack of social protection, and were encouraged towards collective action and skill development.

name: Youth Joint Liability Group
text: Unemployed youth aged 20 to 45 met to explore livelihood and enterprise options, and formed a Joint Liability Group.

name: Women's health & nutrition
text: Awareness on maternal health, menstrual hygiene, balanced diets, anaemia prevention and regular medical check-ups, held on 16 February 2026.
